claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Chloramphenicol is a bacteriostatic 50S ribosomal inhibitor with no meaningful activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; the only plausible human-cell effect would be weak, non-selective protein synthesis inhibition at much higher concentrations.
